schema.sample_usage: For target row j use model_features[j-16:j], y=raw_features[j,4]/capacity_mw
schema.timezone: UTC+08:00 assumed, unverified; original wall-clock timestamp retained
schema.training_missing_policy: reject incomplete histories or invalid target power; no imputation
schema.meteorology_aggregation: mean over (T-15min,T], all 15 valid minute observations required per field
schema.power_timestamp_semantics: source label retained; interval start/end not documented

schema.timezone_basis: Hong Kong local-time hypothesis; noon irradiance supports it, source timestamps have no timezone
